stamp.title: Stamp a message into Bitcoin
stamp.lead: Write a message and it gets a free, permanent place in Bitcoin history. Public calendar servers collect thousands of fingerprints, combine them into one hash, and write that hash into a Bitcoin transaction they pay for.
stamp.howHash: Your browser computes the SHA-256 fingerprint of your message. The text itself never leaves this page.
stamp.howCalendars: The fingerprint is sent to the calendars ({calendars}). Each one adds it to its next batch.
stamp.howBitcoin: Within a few hours a calendar puts the batch root in an OP_RETURN transaction and a miner confirms it. Your stamp then shows the block and the transaction.
stamp.howKeep: Keep the .txt and .ots files: with both, anyone can prove the message existed at that time, here or on opentimestamps.org.
stamp.privacyHint: Only the fingerprint is public. Very short or guessable messages could be confirmed by someone who guesses the exact text.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.lead: Usage is simple. You participate with a little Bitcoin as units of account — at least 0.00001 BTC — then you declare a truth that Bitcoin itself will keep.
howItWorks.sparkBody: Open Spark and send a little Bitcoin to the participation address. Those coins become units of account. Once they are registered in The Block Note, you can take part.
howItWorks.declareBody: Write your message on Declare. The Block Note records it as plain text inside a Bitcoin transaction. Anyone can read it.
howItWorks.permanentBody: After the transaction is accepted into a Bitcoin block, no one can remove the text you entered. That is how Bitcoin works — and how The Block Note reveals it.
howItWorks.close: The Block Note does not hide your words. It shows what Bitcoin already does: public, plain-text records that, once confirmed, cannot be taken back.

anchors.title: Anchoring queue
anchors.lead: Every free declaration, reply and vote waits at the OpenTimestamps calendars until their next Bitcoin transaction is mined. The calendars hand out the finished proof once that block has a few confirmations, usually within an hour or two. Last 7 days.
